title: Safe Room Setup
description: Covers choosing a safe room location, reinforcing doors, windows, and walls, and stocking supplies for weather, security, and shelter-in-place events. Includes communication inside and out, a quick-entry protocol and drills, and ventilation, sanitation, and food for longer stays.
shortDescription: Choose and reinforce a room, stock it, and drill a fast entry
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
